main.description: Bridge a flagged-dead-stock surplus lot into the toshiKozan (都市鉱山) e-waste recovery stream. Per ADR-2605211241. The handoff is 1:1 with a subsequent com.etzhayyim.apps.toshiKozan.registerEwasteStream record. Transitions lot state flagged-dead-stock -> kozan-handoff. The downstream urban-mining cell (60-apps/etzhayyim-project-open-robo/) actually performs the recycling and ultimately reports final material recovery, after which the lot may be transitioned to 'recycled' by a follow-up call.

flagUri.description: AT URI of the prior flagDeadStock event.

recoveryFacilityDid.description: DID of the urban-mining cell / recovery facility receiving the lot. Must be an attested religious-corp downstream actor.

expectedYieldGramsPerTonne.description: Predicted recovery yield by material (g/tonne). Audited later against actual recovery.

co2eKgPerTonneEstimate.description: Estimated CO2e per tonne recovered. Same units as toshiKozan.registerEwasteStream.co2eKgPerTonneRecovered.

kozanStreamRef.description: AT URI of the auto-emitted com.etzhayyim.apps.toshiKozan.registerEwasteStream record.
